title: MultiPlan & out-of-network payments
headline: A clearer picture of your out-of-network payments.
intro: For healthcare practices, facilities and provider groups with questions about MultiPlan-related commercial payments. Start with three simple questions, then explore what a conversation with Devin van der Hahn could look like.

questions.label: What is your role?
questions.help: Choose the closest fit for your practice, facility or group.

questions.label: Did your organization bill commercial out-of-network services during 2015–2026?
questions.help: An estimate is fine. You do not need to upload records here.

questions.label: About how much did you bill annually for those out-of-network services?
questions.help: Use billed charges, not payments received, a claimed loss or a claim’s potential value.
